summary: npm package ships a Cloudflare Turnstile lookalike HTML page that redirects to loofte.live
details: The package contains a single HTML file (referenced by `main`) that imitates a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge. Obfuscated inline JavaScript reconstructs the string 'https://loofte.live/' from a split-string/array wrapper and calls window.location.replace() to that URL, forwarding the current query string, when the Turnstile callback fires. There are no lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) and no JavaScript module entry point, so nothing executes when a developer runs `npm install` or `require`s the package. The abusive behavior targets browser end-users who load the HTML (via the npm registry being used as a static-content CDN), not developers who install the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
